lines.cyr: Заспало девојче, ле, близу до беќарче, леле,
lines.lat: Zaspalo devojče, le, blizu do beḱarče, lele,
lines.en: А young girl fell asleep*, hey, not far was an unmarried man,
hey, not far was an unmarried man.

lines.cyr: Беќарче го гледа, ле, па го тиом буди, леле,
lines.lat: Beḱarče go gleda, le, pa go tiom budi, lele,
lines.en: The young man watched her, hey, and he gently woke her up,
hey, and he gently woke her up.

lines.cyr: Ја стани девојче, ле, да се наджнееме, леле,
lines.lat: Ja stani devojče, le, da se nadžneeme, lele,
lines.en: Get up girl! Let's see who finishes sowing the field first, hey,
who finishes sowing the field first.

lines.cyr: Да се наджнееме, ле, да се наттрчиме, леле,
lines.lat: Da se nadžneeme, le, da se nattrčime, lele,
lines.en: Let's see who finishes sowing the field first, hey,
let's see who can outrun the other.

lines.cyr: Кој прв ќе наджнее, ле, тој прв да се жени, леле,
lines.lat: Koj prv ḱe nadžnee, le, toj prv da se ženi, lele,
lines.en: Who ever finishes sowing first, hey, will get married first, hey,

lines.cyr: Кој прв ќе наттрчи, ле, тебе да те земе, леле,
lines.lat: Koj prv ḱe nattrči, le, tebe da te zeme, lele,
lines.en: Who ever outruns the other, hey, marries you, hey,
